title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 02 April 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 01 April 2026 Atmospheric conditions will be favorable for afternoon thundershowers in most parts of the island over the next few days from tomorrow (02 April). Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in Western, Central, Sabaragamuwa, Southern, Uva, North-western and North-central provinces after 2.00 p.m. Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Western, Central and Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Kurunegala district. A few showers may occur at Ampara, Batticaloa and Hambantota districts in the morning too. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
